title: Wiemer card rail (v2)
description: A full-bleed row of tall 4:5 grey product cards with soft corners, running off both edges of the page. As you scroll, the whole row drifts slowly sideways to the right.
notes: made to follow wiemer-v2-intro directly (it has only a little top padding)
the drift is CSS scroll-driven; without support the row sits still, shifted a little left
the original's rail can also be dragged; this one only drifts
name: wiemer-v2-rail

props.name: cards
props.description: the cards, left to right; give enough to run past the right edge (8 or more)
